criteria.name: Identity, plan footprint, and local frame
criteria.evidence: FID 528 identifies South Hall. The full simplified GIS outline is retained and the reopened base-mesh overlay matches to approximately 2.24 micrometres. The match verifies the transform against the same source polygon, not a separate structural-wall survey. Root is identity.

criteria.name: Vertical massing, connector, and roof
criteria.evidence: Eight residential floors and a low north dining/link arm follow broad Purdue program/site-plan evidence. The exact plan split/endpoint, inferred 14/10-foot floor rhythm, absolute height, and roof form remain estimates or unverified.

criteria.name: Exterior facade, entrance, and materials
criteria.evidence: Brick, framed glazing, a glazed base/entry, and roof variation establish broad character. The facade is very regular and schematic; the prominent tall glazed bay in current construction imagery is not clearly reproduced, and roof/eave articulation is sparse.

criteria.name: Interior and amenities
criteria.evidence: The asset includes representative labs, public amenities, and a sample double room, all explicitly schematic. The cutaway does not communicate coherent connected spaces, circulation, cores, or room adjacencies. Exact room locations are unsupported.

criteria.name: Source evidence and uncertainty handling
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS, a Trustees site plan, housing pages, and 2026 construction references are preserved with provenance and limitations. Plan registration, connector partition, and GIS floor-field unit interpretation remain inferred.

criteria.name: Saved file, materials, and portability
criteria.evidence: Independent Blender 5.2.3 fresh reopen matched the expected hash, 22 objects, identity root, material coverage, and no external image dependencies. Low object detail still limits inspection of this large building.

findings: R1 is a substantial improvement over the prior rectangular slab and preserves the full GIS ground outline.
The eight-story upper shell and one-story connector are plausible broad massing but depend on estimated plan partition and inferred GIS height units.
Facade rhythm, glass bay/atrium, roof articulation, and ground-floor circulation remain too schematic for an 8/10 pass.
The interior cutaway shows representative props but not an understandable connected floor arrangement.
The asset and evidence are portable and reopen cleanly; master placement was not reviewed.
required_before_pass: Add source-informed tall glazed facade/atrium and more representative facade variation without claiming an unverified window schedule.
Rework the ground-floor cutaway to show connected public spaces, clear circulation, and representative partitions/amenities; label room placement schematic.
Clarify the low dining connector transition in exterior views and retain its partition uncertainty.
Keep unsupported roof and height conditions clearly estimated unless stronger source evidence is found.
Reopen master and verify the placement marker during coordinator integration.
limitations: Purdue GIS FID 528 is not a certified wall survey; the model boundary was generated from it.
The site plan is unregistered and does not independently provide a georeferenced connector split.
GIS floor fields have no stated units or verified vertical datum; the feet interpretation is an estimate.
Construction photography can show temporary conditions and does not establish dimensions or as-built room layout.
Master placement was not checked by this standalone asset review.
